family_name: Bradford Anticon Roofing Blanket - Heavy Duty Foil

spec.description:
Bradford Anticon Roofing Blanket - Heavy Duty Foil is a premium
glasswool roofing blanket factory-bonded to an Extra Heavy Duty reflective foil
laminate facing. Specifically engineered for commercial metal roofs and
residential projects with wider purlin or batten spacings (up to 1200mm centres
without mesh), the Heavy Duty foil provides superior tensile strength, tear
resistance, and puncture durability. It prevents underside condensation,
significantly reduces rain drumming noise, and complies with bushfire attack
levels up to BAL-FZ.
features:
Faced with Extra Heavy Duty reflective
foil laminate for maximum tensile and tear strength

Engineered for wider
purlin spacings up to 1200mm without sagging or tearing

Factory-bonded with
a 150mm foil overlap edge for sealed, continuous vapour barriers
Non-combustible glasswool core conforming to AS 1530.1

Bushfire ember
protection certified from BAL 12.5 to BAL FZ under AS 3959

Damps heavy rain
noise by up to 7 dB to deliver quieter building interiors

Reflects up to 97%
of radiant heat entering through metal roofing

Manufactured from up to 65%
recycled glass with FBS-1 bio-soluble formulation

Available in thicknesses
from 60mm to 145mm (R1.3 to R3.6)

Resistant to moisture penetration and
condensation formation

install:
Ensure purlins
or rafters are clean and dry prior to blanket rollout

Roll out Anticon Heavy
Duty over framing with the heavy-duty foil facing down toward the building
interior

Allow a uniform sag of 25-40mm between purlins (up to 1200mm
centres) to ensure thermal recovery

Lap adjacent blanket rolls by 150mm using
the pre-extended foil flap

Tape all foil seams with Bradford 493 Reinforced
Aluminium Foil Tape using a plastic squeegee for an airtight seal

Install
roof spacer systems (e.g. Ashgrid or SpacerX) over purlins if required to
prevent insulation pinch

Fasten metal roof cladding immediately over the
blanket or spacer bars
selection_checklist:
Confirm purlin or batten
spacing exceeds 900mm (up to 1200mm centres requires Heavy Duty foil)

Verify
commercial or residential metal roof profile and pitch

Confirm required
thermal R-value under NCC Section J or residential energy requirements

Ensure
heavy-duty foil tape (Bradford 493) is specified for all joint sealing

Check
BAL rating compliance (BAL 12.5 to BAL FZ)
limitations:
Do not install in wet weather; glasswool must
remain completely dry

Must be installed with foil facing downwards into the
roof space
Spans exceeding 1200mm require safety mesh support underneath

use_cases:
Commercial metal roof construction with wide purlin spacings up to 1200mm
without safety mesh

Industrial warehouses, distribution centres, and
factories requiring high tear-resistant roof sarking

Bushfire-prone
residential homes requiring BAL-FZ compliant under-roof insulation
not_for:
Vertical wall insulation
without outer cladding
retrieval.rag_summary:
Bradford Anticon
Roofing Blanket - Heavy Duty Foil is an Australian-made glasswool insulation
blanket laminated to an Extra Heavy Duty reflective foil facing with a 150mm
overlap edge. Designed specifically for commercial and wide-span residential
metal roofs with purlin centres up to 1200mm, its robust foil backing resists
tearing and sagging while forming a Class 2 vapour barrier to prevent
condensation. Offering R-values from R1.3 to R3.6, rain sound attenuation up
to 7 dB, and BAL-FZ bushfire resistance, it delivers heavy-duty thermal and
moisture protection for metal roofs.
